description: Source code for a JSON reporter class used in Playwright testing framework to serialize test results into JSON format, including methods for report serialization, suite merging, and file output.

classes.name: JSONReporter
classes.description: Implements a test reporter that serializes test results into JSON format for Playwright.

methods.name: printsToStdio
methods.description: Indicates whether the reporter outputs to stdout.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Sets the full configuration for the reporter.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Records an error encountered during testing.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Serializes and outputs the report at the end of testing.

methods.name: _serializeReport
methods.description: Converts test results and suite data into JSON report format.

methods.name: _mergeSuites
methods.description: Merges suite data from multiple sources into a unified structure.

methods.name: _relativeLocation
methods.description: Converts absolute file locations to relative paths.

methods.name: _locationMatches
methods.description: Checks if two locations match based on file, line, and column.

methods.name: _mergeTestsFromSuite
methods.description: Merges test cases and suites into a parent suite.

methods.name: _serializeSuite
methods.description: Serializes a suite and its nested suites/tests into JSON format.

methods.name: _serializeTestSpec
methods.description: Serializes a test case into JSON report format.

methods.name: _serializeTestResult
methods.description: Serializes detailed test result including steps, errors, and attachments.

methods.name: _serializeError
methods.description: Formats an error into JSON report error structure.

methods.name: _serializeTestStep
methods.description: Serializes a test step and its nested steps.
